status: draft for expanded consumer edition; native/UI/signing/device validation and final declarations pending
name: Fire Privacy
subtitle: Understand your app activity
promotionalText: Explore exported activity with evidence-backed guidance and encrypted history. Optional protections and advisor requests have explicit consent and data-flow controls.
proposedPrivacyLabel: Pending final operator/dependency review: local-only processing is not collection; optional DNS/advisor/update endpoints and their retention/access must be assessed under Apple’s collection definition. Do not copy the earlier blanket Data Not Collected proposal.
ageRating: Complete the current App Store Connect questionnaire; do not copy a preassigned rating
sellerIdentity: Use the verified enrolled seller identity; not inferred from the repository
bundleIdentifier: Must match the registered ID used by the signed archive
build: Set a unique build number before upload
edition: consumer; Safari and encrypted-DNS adapters; URL-filter/managed editions excluded
optionalFeatureDisclosures: Resolver query visibility/retention; exact HTTPS model/update payload and destination; supported on-device model availability; Safari coverage and removal limits
